current_candidate.signature:
theorem harmonic_closedBall_mean_value {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hu : ∃ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ,
      InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd v (Metric.closedBall a r) ∧
      Set.EqOn v u (Metric.closedBall a r)) :
    let τ : MeasureTheory.Measure (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) :=
      (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).toSphere
    (∫ ζ : Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1,
      u (a + r • (ζ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) ∂((τ Set.univ)⁻¹ • τ)) = u a
current_candidate.current_binding_target: V2 only; no V1-interface acceptance is carried over.

historical_interface_drift.reason: V1 asked the arbitrary total representative u itself to be harmonic near K, thereby constraining off-K behavior which the source closed-set extension convention leaves free. V2 asks for a matching harmonic witness and EqOn only on K. This diagnoses interface overrestriction; it does not refute HFT1.4 or claim V1 mathematical falsehood.
historical_interface_drift.immutability: Both V1 and V2 seals are retained byte-for-byte. The raw graph remains a historical V1-bound record; this overlay supplies current binding metadata without rewriting it.

prior_challenge_boundary.use: The listed required corrections define this limited repair scope. This overlay does not revise that verdict, treat its own proposals as accepted, or claim the blocking finding has been independently closed.

critical_source_facts.content: Harmonic on arbitrary E means admitting a harmonic extension to an open set containing E.
The overbarred closed ball is the hypothesis domain; the observations are center a and a+r zeta for unit zeta.
Affine normalization, annular Green, zero flux, surface normalization and continuity use the harmonic extension. The n>2 power and n=2 logarithm source branches are unchanged.

source_reinspection.additional_allowed_input: The exact frozen source graph and pinned challenge were read for adapter sites; no production Lean, Mathlib definitions, root proof reasoning, or outside mathematical source was read.

frozen_graph_current_view.notation_policy: Author proof symbols are interpreted as functions on their stated/implicit harmonic extension domains. In current V2 instantiation, normalized source u is w=v_ext composed T. Source radial v is renamed phi in this overlay to avoid collision with the sealed existential v_ext. This is a semantic instantiation, not a rewritten author proof.

interface_obligations.content: Justify both representations of the source extension convention. From the selected candidate neighborhood representative, obtain an open U containing K on which v_ext is C^2 with zero source coordinate Laplacian, so v_ext restricted to U is a source harmonic extension matching u on K. Conversely, from a source real harmonic f on such U, obtain a total representative agreeing with f on U; values outside U may be arbitrary, and locality must give the candidate neighborhood harmonicity. Do not demand regularity or measurability of that representative outside U, or of original u outside K. The actual formal harmonicity semantics and locality assembly have not been inspected or proved.
